AVeriTeC.finding: E1 changed recipes but was exactly tied with RAW on all 36 scored items; the small HippoRAG difference therefore was not a causal RAW improvement

BRIGHT_P9.finding: P9 was positive against HippoRAG in all three preregistered families, but was negative, tied, and positive respectively against RAW
BRIGHT_P9.implication: the three-family double-baseline condition remains false

EntailmentBank.finding: Q1 strongly exceeded RAW in all three families and narrowly exceeded HippoRAG overall, but its family deltas against HippoRAG were positive in only one family and zero in two
EntailmentBank.implication: a large RAW gain can still fail the stable HippoRAG condition

HybridQA_P6_E2.finding: a true evaluator promotion and authorized untouched search occurred, but the future-search improvement was not stable and the selected policy tied RAW
HybridQA_P6_E2.mechanism_already_tested: retain RAW top three and fill two residual slots from direct or typed-path candidates

Hotpot_2Wiki_MuSiQue.finding: frozen typed retrieval produced useful RAW gains and L4 retention in several cohorts, while evaluator challengers did not produce L5 promotion and future-search improvement
Hotpot_2Wiki_MuSiQue.implication: L4 evidence does not substitute for L5

QASC.finding: HippoRAG materially exceeded both incumbent and challenger and the challenger did not promote
QASC.implication: another global recipe evaluator is not justified

recent_source_sequence.scope: FRAMES through BIRD inclusive; persistent user-service P0 excluded

forbidden_continuations: another source selected before the consumed-data architecture decision
another RAW-top-three plus two residual slots global recipe study
RRF, keyword, prompt, threshold, or gate tuning
replay, retry, resampling, or repair of a consumed formal root
using HybridQA retrospective results as fresh efficacy evidence

meta_development_contract.candidate_action: replace one still-present original RAW top-five slot with one query-anchored typed candidate outside the original RAW top five
meta_development_contract.candidate_universe: all direct-anchor or at-most-two-edge typed-path candidates; no positive-gain candidate filter

evaluator.fit: fixed no-intercept weighted ridge with lambda one on exact candidate marginal utility
evaluator.trajectory: at most two distinct original RAW slots; training uses deterministic oracle trajectories and held-block inference uses only the learned action scorer

go_requirements: held-block oracle strictly exceeds RAW in every block and every family
cross-fitted learned policy strictly exceeds RAW in every held block
pooled cross-fitted learned policy strictly exceeds RAW in every family
pooled cross-fitted learned policy strictly exceeds the fixed HybridQA P6 path-two recipe
pooled learned-minus-RAW exact one-sided magnitude-preserving sign-flip p is at most 0.10
meta_development_contract.mechanism_difference: the evaluator scores concrete per-item replacement actions by predicted marginal utility; it does not select one global recipe and does not merely reserve two residual slots
meta_development_contract.single_terminal_rule: one frozen diagnostic; failure stops this mechanism without feature, threshold, fold, gate, prompt, or source modification

next_after_terminal.fail: stop the total-goal efficacy search under the current architecture and report the narrower supported conclusion
next_after_terminal.pass: register exactly one independent confirmatory source, freeze Agent_RAW_official_HippoRAG, A_hold promotion, and conditional untouched M_search before source selection

remaining_total_goal_gaps: strict Agent advantage over RAW and official HippoRAG in aggregate and each of at least three preregistered real-domain relation families
a challenger evaluator that promotes on independent A_hold and improves a prefrozen untouched M_search
